subject: Private deployment: EU data residency + limited host-access approval request
messages:
From: John Harper <john.harper@medtech.example>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.example, marissa.cole@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment: EU residency + limited host-access request

Hi Rachel / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week. MedTech liked the Dedicated option but we have two must-haves before procurement can move forward:

1) Full EU data residency for inference storage and GPU-backed state (no replication outside EU).
2) A limited "host access" clause so our on-call SREs can request short-lived access to the host to capture debugging traces and trigger restarts during incidents. We understand this is non-standard; our security team proposes a process:
   - Access only via customer-approved jumpbox session broker
   - Sessions logged and timeboxed (max 30 minutes)
   - Written request + incident ticket required

We also need a 12-month committed term, and are asking for a one-time onboarding credit plus a 18% committed-term discount tied to a volume commit.

I've attached our requested redlines (MedTech_Requested_Redlines_20260602.docx). Procurement is ready to sign quickly if we can get exec sign-off on both the discount and the host-access guardrails.

Best,
John Harper
Head of Infrastructure
MedTech Solutions Inc.

Attachments: MedTech_Requested_Redlines_20260602.docx (docx)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.example>
To: John Harper <john.harper@medtech.example>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.example, karthik.iyer@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: EU residency + limited host-access request

John — thanks, and appreciate the clear asks. Looping legal/ops (Marissa + Karthik on cc) for a quick decision. Summary of the non-standard items we need approval on:

- Data residency: customer requires all inference state (KV cache snapshots, model artifacts, logs) to reside only in the EU dedicated GPU pool; no cross-region replication.
- Host access: customer requests SRE access for debugging + restarts. This is sensitive because it implies host-level operations on dedicated infra.
- KMS model: customer wants customer-managed KMS with double-encryption (Redwood encryption + customer CMK) and local HSM custody.
- Audit window: customer asks for ad-hoc onsite audits with 48-hour notice and read-write access to logs; Redwood prefers remote, read-only logs export.

Commercial asks: 18% committed-term discount for a 12-month committed spend + waiver of the standard $30k onboarding SOW fee.

From a product/ops perspective, the host-access ask is the biggest blocker: we can offer operator-assisted restarts, session brokered captures, and a strict jumpbox + ephemeral support access flow, but granting direct host SSH or admin keys is not something our standard private deployment supports without additional controls and legal guardrails. Legal will want to avoid host-level key custody by customers.

Can we get expedited exec approval on two items so we can return a firm offer to MedTech: (1) approve discount up to 18% (or counter with max approved), and (2) approve a constrained variant of the host-access request (operator-assisted, brokered sessions, recorded and timeboxed) with explicit SOW and higher indemnity/insurance? If approved, I'll draft the customer-facing concession and update the redlines.

--
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

+1 415-555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.example>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.example, marissa.cole@redwood.example, john.harper@medtech.example
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: EU residency + limited host-access request

Rachel / Marissa / John — after reviewing Legal + Ops input I can approve a constrained set of concessions to close this quarter, with these firm conditions: 

1) Discount: approve a maximum 15% committed-term discount for a 12-month commit. The 18% ask exceeds commercial levers without CFO sign-off. 15% is the approved counter-offer.

2) Host access: direct customer SSH or host admin keys are NOT approved. Instead we will accept an "operator-assisted session" flow:
   - Customer may request a brokered support session (max 30 minutes) during declared maintenance windows or P1 incidents.
   - Redwood operator performs any host-level actions; customer may observe and capture logs via the session broker.
   - All sessions will be recorded, session transcripts retained for 90 days, and a session ticket ID required.

3) Data residency/KMS: full EU-only residency on dedicated GPU pool is approved. Customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-KMS) is acceptable only if keys never leave the customer's HSM and Redwood only holds a wrapped key; Legal will add contract language to prohibit handing over raw key material. This will require a $25k integration SOW (to cover ops changes).

4) Audits: no unrestricted onsite admin access. Audits must be remote and read-only unless separately negotiated under a specific audit SOW with minimum 30 days' notice; ad-hoc in-person audits are not permitted.

5) Commercial trade: onboarding SOW fee will not be waived in full. We will discount $15k of the SOW fee (customer pays remaining $10k) in exchange for immediate signature at the agreed counter.

Next steps (Rachel/Marissa): please draft counter-redlines reflecting the above and circulate DocuSign. Send final draft to john.harper@medtech.example and cc legal@redwood.example. If MedTech accepts the 15% + $10k SOW remainder + operator-assisted access flow, we can close and onboard in the EU dedicated pool within the lead time noted.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales Operations (Deal Desk)
Redwood Inference
